added: Every list tab (Chores, Tasks, Memos) now opens with a thin coloured strip naming the page, in the same colour as the highlighted tab in the bottom bar, so it is always clear which tab you are on.
changed: The Memos tab's large top bar is replaced by the same thin strip used on the other tabs, giving the list more room.
fixed: Swipe action panels (Done, Log, Delete) now appear only while you are actually swiping a row, so a coloured panel no longer shows behind cards at rest.
